name: Public
description: Non-sensitive information safe for public distribution

name: Internal
description: Internal use only — not for external distribution

name: Confidential
description: Sensitive business data requiring access controls

name: Restricted
description: Highly sensitive data — regulated or legally protected (PII, PHI, PCI)

name: PII
description: Personally Identifiable Information (names, SSN, Aadhaar, addresses)

name: PCI
description: Payment Card Industry data (credit cards, CVV, cardholder data)

name: PHI
description: Protected Health Information (medical records, diagnoses, prescriptions)

name: FINANCIAL
description: Financial records (bank accounts, transactions, tax documents)

name: CREDENTIALS
description: Authentication secrets (API keys, passwords, tokens, private keys)

name: SOURCE_CODE
description: Proprietary source code and intellectual property

name: LEGAL
description: Legal documents, contracts, attorney-client privileged material

name: HR
description: Human resources data (employee records, compensation, performance)
